code:allowMcpServers.reason: A cloud Code session declares no MCP servers to the server: the harness inside the sandbox configures its own, so there is no server call to refuse. Enforcing it needs the session to carry its MCP servers.

code:sessionRetentionDays.reason: The code_sessions domain sweep reads its window from the domain policy alone and never takes the smaller Code value.

feature:hooks.reason: Hooks run on the caller's own machine, so the server has no call to refuse; it publishes the switch and the CLI and desktop honour it.
